values.meaning: duration of the active's doubled bonus movement speed
values.quote: doubles the {{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}} for 3 seconds

values.meaning: time without taking damage before passive activates
values.quote: gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 5 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage

mechanics.claim: Move Quick's passive move speed is only granted after 5 seconds without taking non-damage-over-time damage from enemy champions or turrets.
mechanics.quote: gains {{sti|ms|{{as|'''bonus''' movement speed}}}} after 5 seconds without taking non-{{tip|persistent damage|over time}} damage from enemy {{tip|champions}} or {{tip|turrets}}

mechanics.claim: Casting the active does not interrupt Guerrilla Warfare (camouflage).
mechanics.quote: Casting Move Quick does not interrupt {{ai|Guerrilla Warfare|Teemo}}.

mechanics.claim: While the active is up, the passive bonus cannot be removed by taking damage.
mechanics.quote: preventing it from being removed for the duration

mechanics.claim: If Teemo is damaged during the active's duration, he will not regain the passive speed once the active ends.
mechanics.quote: When ''Move Quick's'' active bonus movement speed ends '''Teemo''' will not regain the passive one if he was damaged during the active's duration.

mechanics.claim: The passive is disabled by damage even if that damage is blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: ''Move Quick's'' passive will be disabled even if the damage is blocked with a {{tip|spell shield}}.
